title: Manjar (Dulce de Leche)
hookLine: Global-inspired manjar (dulce de leche) with 4 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Bring milk, sugar, and vanilla extract to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, continue cooking, and continuously stirring until milk has thickened and turned a caramel color, about 1 hour or more. Incorporate {m53515_1} and {m53515_2} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53515_3} and {m53515_4} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir in baking soda. Continue cooking until caramelized milk has reached a pudding consistency. Pour manjar into a bowl and cool completely in the refrigerator.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Manjar (Dulce de Leche) coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 4 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
